title: The Bell Estate
motive_summary: Marcus Bell rewrote his estate beneficiaries on the day he died, cutting out his business partner Isabella and the clinic in favour of a distant nephew. Ruth Calder — secretly Marcus's half-sister, cut out of the family inheritance decades ago — had waited years for this opening. She poisoned Marcus's evening cocoa with a plant extract, knowing the death would be attributed to his heart condition. She intended to contest the will as next-of-kin.
overview_text: 07:15 — Marcus Bell, the village's retired property developer, is found dead in his chair by Priya Shah, who had a standing early-morning appointment. The death initially appears natural — Marcus had a known heart condition. The investigation spans the previous evening from 18:00.
notes: This is the hardest case. Ruth is trusted, methodical, and superficially helpful. Her connection to Marcus is not on any public record — investigators must find the family documents she thought she had already destroyed.
